sampling: Three eras x three absolute height groups; within each cell select advantage rank .10,.35,.50,.65,.90; lower<.20, middle .20-.80, upper>.80. No outcomes.
replacement_rule: At most one replacement per unavailable original, same era/height/relative stratum, lowest SHA256(ID:year) among unused reserve; preserve original. Only activate if a same-stratum official source route is found. Log every replacement.
pair_identity: same player AND exact combine year; explicit barefoot field only
rounding: difference <=0.125 inches only when source precision <=0.25 inches; coarse source values separately flagged, not counted toward release
pass_rule: At least 30 direct official fine-precision same-year pairs; >=95% exact/rounding-consistent; all three eras and all three height and relative strata represented; no unresolved substantive or systematic discrepancy; reference clean; tests pass; no outcome analysis.
systematic_rule: Flag an unresolved field offset when >=3 nonzero discrepancies share sign within an era or height stratum and their median absolute size exceeds 0.125 inch; also flag any explicit repeated unit/shoe-vs-barefoot mismatch. No significance test.
fail_rule: FAIL — MATERIAL SOURCE CONFLICT when authoritative evidence shows an unresolved systematic discrepancy or a substantive conflict that cannot be safely quarantined without changing the frozen population; otherwise insufficient evidence yields PARTIAL — INSUFFICIENT DIRECT VALIDATION.
